description: This file defines classes and functions for a BabyAGI system, including task creation, prioritization, execution, and management of task list, utilizing language models and vector store for AI task automation.

classes.name: TaskCreationChain
classes.description: Handles creation of new tasks based on AI output.

classes.name: TaskPrioritizationChain
classes.description: Handles reordering and prioritization of tasks.

classes.name: BabyAGI
classes.description: Main class orchestrating task management, execution, and prioritization.

methods.name: from_llm
methods.description: Creates chain instances from a language model.

methods.name: get_next_task
methods.description: Generates new tasks based on previous results.

methods.name: get_top_tasks
methods.description: Retrieves top relevant tasks from vector store.

methods.name: executeTask
methods.description: Executes a task using the execution chain.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Main method to run the task loop, managing task execution and creation.
